title: Over-the-Counter Allowance Amounts and Order Limits by PrairieRx Plan
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — over-the-counter (OTC) allowance table.**

| PrairieRx plan | Quarterly OTC allowance | Unused allowance rolls over (plan setting) | Channels where the allowance may be spent | Mail catalog and online orders per quarter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | $0.00 | No | None | 0 |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | $25.00 | No | Retail pharmacy, mail catalog, online | 1 |
| PrairieRx Adult | $25.00 | No | Retail pharmacy, mail catalog, online | 1 |
| PrairieRx Children | $25.00 | No | Retail pharmacy, mail catalog, online | 1 |
| PrairieRx Maternity | $50.00 | No | Retail pharmacy, mail catalog, online | 2 |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | $35.00 | No | Retail pharmacy, mail catalog, online | 2 |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | $0.00 | No | None | 0 |

The quarterly allowance is the plan's quarterly allowance amount in USD, stated to the cent.

### Reading the table

- PrairieRx Dual Wrap and PrairieRx Long-Term Care carry no OTC allowance, no spending channel and 0 mail catalog or online orders.
- PrairieRx Maternity carries the largest quarterly allowance, $50.00, and with PrairieRx Complex Care ($35.00) allows 2 mail catalog or online orders per quarter; the three $25.00 plans allow 1.
- Retail pharmacy purchases are not an "order" in the last column; that column counts mail catalog and online orders only.
